basic_profile.bio: An avid Doctor Who fan and long-time Redditor based in Munich, Germany. I have a background in IT and currently work as a software developer. My interests include science fiction, particularly British TV shows, and European football. I am usually online in the evenings after work and on weekends. Single and a frequent attendee of sci-fi conventions when possible.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise stems from a combination of formal education in computer science and a life-long passion for science fiction and technology. I am self-taught in various programming languages and have a deep understanding of pop culture, especially British television series.
